context_for_next_testing_agent: Audit Trail and CSV Export features fully tested. Audit log endpoint at GET /api/audit-logs with filters: action, entity_type, user_name, date_from, date_to, page, limit. CSV export at GET /api/deals/export with same filters as GET /api/deals. Actions logged: deal_created, deal_confirmed, deal_returned, deal_cancelled, proof_uploaded, proof_deleted, user_created, user_updated, user_deleted. Only admins can access audit logs.

audit_trail.details: Audit Trail page at /audit-log accessible only to admin. Shows table with Timestamp, Action, Entity, Reference, User, Details columns. Filters for Action, Entity Type, User, Date From, Date To. Action badges color-coded. Pagination supported. Actions logged: deal_created, deal_confirmed, deal_returned, deal_cancelled, proof_uploaded, proof_deleted, user_created, user_updated, user_deleted.

csv_export.details: Export CSV button on My Deals (trader) and Transactions (admin/treasury). Downloads CSV with all deal fields including reference_number, client_name, transaction_type, buy_currency, sell_currency, status, etc. Respects same filters as deal listing. Filename format: deals_export_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.csv or my_deals_export_YYYY-MM-DD.csv.

csv_export_endpoint.access: All authenticated users (traders see only their deals)
